events.headline: The Clay Skills Marketplace Is Open
events.summary: Clay opened a Skills Marketplace with GTM skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

events.headline: Clay adds 24 new or updated integrations
events.summary: Clay released 24 new or updated integrations. An aggregator says they target EMEA and APAC coverage.

events.headline: Clay partners with Marketbridge on enterprise GTM execution
events.summary: Clay's enrichment and orchestration platform is paired with Marketbridge's GTM strategy and measurement services for large enterprises. The date comes from an aggregator. A search snippet of the Demand Gen Report article said October 6, 2026, but that page returned 403 and could not be opened.

events.headline: Sculpt 2026: agent-first building and Clay Workflows beta
events.summary: At Sculpt 2026 Clay launched an agent that plans, runs and improves GTM plays from an outcome-based request. Sculpt attendees get it now and early-access users get it in the coming weeks. Clay Workflows, a canvas for complex plays, is in beta for all users and launches fully this fall.

events.headline: Clay previews Inbound SDR Agent
events.summary: Clay previewed an Inbound SDR Agent at Sculpt 2026 and opened a pre-beta waitlist. No release date was given.

events.headline: Clay hiring cluster in private equity and partner ecosystem roles
events.summary: An aggregator flagged a cluster of new roles in PE and partner ecosystem functions. As of 2026-10-26 it counted 50 open roles: 46 in the US and 4 in the UK.

events.headline: Clay ships SCIM provisioning, signals-to-workflows and metro area search
events.summary: Clay added SCIM user provisioning, a way to route signals into workflows, and metro area search. This comes from the aggregator only.

events.headline: Clay holds first Partner Day and announces 2026 Data Partner Awards
events.summary: Clay named 10 data partner award winners, with HG Insights as Data Partner of the Year. LeadMagic became the first partner to pass 1 billion enrichment runs.

events.headline: Claygent auto-mode picks a model per task
events.summary: Claygent's new auto-mode picks a model for each task. Clay says it costs 47% less than always using the most capable model.
